name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: Navbar. Best for: The top of a site: the brand, up to about six main links and a few actions.

import { useState, type ReactNode, type Ref } from 'react' import { Menu } from 'lucide-react' import { cn } from '../../../lib/cn' import { renderAnchor, type LinkRenderProps } from '../../../lib/render-link' import { IconButton } from '../../atoms/icon-button/IconButton' import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetTrigger } from '../sheet/Sheet' export type NavbarItem = { label: string; href: string; current?: boolean } export type NavbarProps = { /** Required: the nav landmark's name. Two navs on one page need two names. */ label: string /** The wordmark or logo, usually a link home. */ brand: ReactNode items: NavbarItem[] /** Right-hand controls: icon buttons, a cart link, an account menu. Keep them small; they stay * visible at every width. */ actions?: ReactNode /** How each link is drawn. Defaults to a plain anchor. */ renderLink?: (props: LinkRenderProps) => ReactNode /** The menu button's name and the sheet's title. @default 'Menu' */ menuLabel?: string /** Shown in the menu sheet under the links: an action that lives in `actions` on a wide bar but * has no room there on a narrow one. Hide its `actions` twin below the bar's own breakpoint * with a wrapper carrying `hidden @2xl:flex`. */ menuFooter?: ReactNode className?: string ref?: Ref } /** * Contrast rows, by exact name. Resting link: "text.secondary on surface.base", and "alert body and ghost * dismiss (text.secondary) on surface.raised (over surface.base)" inside a docs Example. Hovered: * "hover wash text (text.primary) on accent.signal.wash over surface.base" and "hover wash text * (text.primary) on accent.signal.wash over surface.raised (over surface.base)". Current: "accent. * signal.ink on accent.signal.indicator", the fill itself "sidebar active item fill on surface.base" and * "rating filled star (accent.signal.indicator) on surface.raised (over surface.base)". Focus: "focus.ring * on surface.base" and "focus ring (focus.ring) on surface.raised (over surface.base)". */ const LINK = cn( 'inline-flex items-center min-h-10 px-3 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] transition-control', // Outside the link, on the surface: on the fill the ring would vanish, and on the wash it measures // under 3:1 in light theme. 'focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--color-focus-ring)]' ) const LINK_REST = 'text-[var(--color-text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--color-text-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--color-accent-signal-wash)]' const LINK_CURRENT = 'font-semibold bg-[var(--color-accent-signal-indicator)] text-[var(--color-accent-signal-indicator-ink)]' export function Navbar({ label, brand, items, actions, renderLink = renderAnchor, menuLabel = 'Menu', menuFooter, className, ref, }: NavbarProps) { const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false) const link = (item: NavbarItem, extra?: string, onClick?: () => void) => renderLink({ href: item.href, className: cn(LINK, item.current ? LINK_CURRENT : LINK_REST, extra), 'aria-current': item.current ? 'page' : undefined, onClick, children: item.label, }) return (
